race.comment: TALAKAI (10) handy mare who comes to hand quickly. Returned from a lengthy break with a tough on pace second over 1100m at Narromine with the 60kg. Proven second up and gets map favours today. Hard to stop. LANG PARK (5) doesn't win out of turn but will appreciate the weight relief with the claim. Kept finding with the 62kg when fourth over 1300m at Dubbo. Proven in this grade and has genuine winning claims. MOON ZONE (9) consistent mare who looks ready for this stronger race after the determined win over 1300m at Dubbo. Will appreciate the drop in weight and comes up with the right gate again. NEWS BOUND (7) strengthened over the break and looking for this trip now. Registered a strong win two runs ago then was a close up fifth over 1300m at Narromine. Value contender. TIGER TOWN (8) strips fitter third up and goes into the exotics.
